title: Le Monde NDE 1041
content:
I was at my boyfriend's parent's house, we had just had lunch. We wanted to have a sauna session, that's something I had never tried before but I thought that could relax me, because I felt tired. Half an hour later, the temperature inside the sauna reached more than sixty degrees, almost seventy. I decided to go out of the room because I felt oppressed by the heat. The sauna's room led to a garage without heating, and the air was fresh outside since we were in December. My friend advised me to go out gradually to avoid any thermal shock but as soon as I set foot outside, I felt myself being invaded by a giddiness, and a huge pain in all my body. I held onto my friend, feeling that I was going to faint, then I began to howl, without really being aware of my screams; I was already losing consciousness. I saw the black wrapping me. I had an awful noise in my ears and in my head, a deafening noise; but maybe it was my screams because my friend maintained that I howled and that he was very afraid. I remember this intense pain and I remember having, at the same time, a life review with short pieces, experiences that even I didn't recall, coming back in my mind. That's difficult to explain, but all that gave me the feeling of being in a fast deafening carrousel with the scenes of my own life. I saw my father, my brother and my sister and more particularly my grandfather who was smiling to me, but also one of my uncles deceased a few years before. I felt myself floating and rotating. Then I didn't feel my body anymore, I had the impression of being nothing anymore, of not existing physically anymore. Then I saw what was really happening; my recumbent body; my friend shaking me, trying to make me wake; and his father who joined him and who slapped my cheek. I had the impression of observing what was happening from above as if I had an external view on what was occurring. I heard them shouting, speaking. First, I didn't understand what they told me. Then I found myself back in my own body, as if I had been sent into my body; suddenly I came back to life and reality. It was difficult for me to open my eyes and, while waking up, I was told that I was very pale, livid, and that during this accident I had my eyes with the whites showing, the body arched tight, and finally completely relaxed, as if lifeless. After this episode, for several days, I felt an intense tiredness, a need to sleep. I went back home, and told my parents what happened, they told me, 'That's unbelievable, your grandfather called a few minutes ago to tell us that he had the feeling you were very bad, that you had a problem, that you were in danger.'

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt "floating and rotating"; also "didn't feel my body anymore" and "the impression of being nothing anymore".

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heat/sauna followed by sudden exposure to cold air (possible thermal shock) leading to fainting/loss of consciousness.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/blackness and deafening noise during loss of consciousness; floating/rotating sensation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackness/noise and intense pain with a brief life review occurred as consciousness was fading; then floating/rotating and loss of bodily sense; then an OBE observing the body and others; then an involuntary return to the body.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Life review occurred "at the same time" as the intense pain while losing consciousness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-episode report that the experiencer's grandfather (alive) called the parents saying he felt she was in danger at that time.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw the black wrapping me.”; “a life review with short pieces… a fast deafening carrousel with the scenes of my own life.”; “I had the impression of observing what was happening from above.”; “I found myself back in my own body, as if I had been sent into my body.”
